race.comment: Former NSW-based galloper MAQUISA (6) wasn't too far away when having her first local run and will have taken a lot of benefit from that hit-out. Should get a cosy run in transit from gate two and is sure to find this easier than what she faced down south. Keep very safe. DYAMI (1) has hit the frame at his past three efforts and gets a stack of weight relief with the 3kg claim. Should be right there at the business end. MURKADO (7) resumes here but the form he showed in his first preparation was good enough for a race of this calibre. In the mix while fresh. ASHKIRK (10) is a first-up winner who shouldn't be underestimated.
